title: Recognitiō: Syntaxis Integra
subtitle: Cōnspectus fīnālis Gradūs VI: trēs cōnstrūctiōnēs ōrātiōnis oblīquae, adiectīva verbālia, ūsūs cāsuum, particulae, stilus — praeparātiō ad textūs authenticōs Gradūs VII.
objectives: Recognōscere et applicāre integrē trēs cōnstrūctiōnēs ōrātiōnis oblīquae, ēligendō correcte secundum verbum regēns
Recitāre discrīmen -τέος (necessitās) vs. -τός (possibilitās), et cāsum agentis proprium (datīvus) prō -τέος
Cōnsolidāre ūsūs cāsuum prōvectiōrēs (praesertim systēma trichotomicum temporāle) et particulās frequentissimās
Sentīre praeparātiōnem plēnam ad Gradum VII: legere textūs authenticōs Xenophontis, Platōnis, aliōrum, sine adiūtōriō gradātō

content.intro: Gradus VI addidit ad fundāmentum grammaticum (Gradibus I-V) trēs elementa fīnālia necessāria prō lēctiōne prōsae authenticae: cōnstrūctiōnēs ōrātiōnis oblīquae variōrum verbōrum, syntaxem cāsuum/particulārum idiōmaticam, et cōnscientiam stilisticam (ōrdō, hyperbaton, structūra sententiae). Duae lēctiōnēs adaptātae (Xenophōn, Platōn) applicāvērunt hoc omne in contextū continuō. Hic gradus conclūditur; Gradus VII removet omne "adiūtōrium" adaptātiōnis et offert verba ipsa antīquōrum.
content.explanation: Discipulus quī hunc gradum complēvit potest nunc: distinguere quam cōnstrūctiōnem oblīquam quodque verbum requīrit; reconhōscere adiectīva verbālia et cāsum agentis proprium eōrum; nāvigāre systēma cāsuum temporāle trichotomicum; "legere" particulās ut structūram argūmentī, nōn sōlum vocābulum; et reconhōscere quandō complexitās sententiae reflectit stilum architectūrālis (nōn grammaticam novam).

rules.heading: a) Cōnspectus: Ōrātiō Oblīqua
rules.body:
Classis VerbīCōnstrūctiō
dīcendī/putandī (λέγω, νομίζω)acc. + īnfīnītīvus
dīcendī/nūntiandī (alt., ἀγγέλλω)ὅτι/ὡς + modus fīnītus
sciendī/percipiendī (οἶδα, ὁρῶ)acc. + participium

rules.heading: b) Cōnspectus: Adiectīva Verbālia et Cāsūs Prōvectiōrēs
rules.body: -τέος (necessitās, agēns DATĪVŌ) vs. -τός (possibilitās, sine cōnstrūctiōne agentis speciālī). Systēma temporāle: accūsātīvus (per quantum), genetīvus (intrā quod), datīvus (quō pūnctō). Datīvus possessiōnis (ἔστι μοι = "habeō"); accūsātīvus respectūs ("quod attinet ad").

rules.heading: c) Cōnspectus: Particulae et Stilus
rules.body: Postpositīvae (γάρ causāle, δέ continuātīvum/adversātīvum lēve, οὖν īnferentiāle) vs. ἀλλά (adversātīvum forte, prīmum verbum). Μέν...δέ balantia. Γε/δή ēmphasis. Ōrdō verbōrum līber sed sīgnificāns (positiō = focus); hyperbaton = ēmphasis dēlīberāta; stilus cōnexus (Herodotus/Xenophōn) vs. periodicus (Thucydidēs/Dēmosthenēs).

examples: λέγει τὸν ἄνδρα σοφὸν εἶναι — ambiguus? nōn, cōnstrūctiō correcta prō λέγω (acc.+īnf.).
οἶδα τὸν ἄνδρα σοφὸν ὄντα — cōnstrūctiō correcta prō οἶδα (acc.+participium).
ἡ πόλις λυτέα ἡμῖν ἐστίν — datīvus agentis, cōnstrūctiō -τέος.
τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἐπορεύοντο, τριῶν δὲ ἡμερῶν ἀφίξονται — extēnsiō (acc.) vs. intrā (gen.), coniūncta in ūnā sententiā.
ὁ μὲν σοφός, ὁ δὲ μωρός· ἀλλ' ἄμφω φίλοι. — Alius quidem sapiēns, alius vērō stultus; sed ambō amīcī. (μέν/δέ + ἀλλά fortis)
τὸν λόγον ὁ ἀνὴρ εἶπεν, οὐ τὸ ἔργον. — Verbum vir dīxit, nōn opus. (ēmphasis per ōrdinem, contrāstus implicitus)

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre acc.+īnfīnītīvum ubīque in ōrātiōne oblīquā, ignōrandō verba quae requīrunt participium (sciendī/percipiendī).
commonMistakes.right: Semper cōnsīderāre classem sēmanticam verbī regentis ante ēligere cōnstrūctiōnem oblīquam.
commonMistakes.why: Error repetitus per hunc gradum, dignus reaffirmāre ad fīnem: nūlla cōnstrūctiō ūnica servit omnibus verbīs Graecīs, dīversē ā Latīnō.

commonMistakes.wrong: Neglegere particulās in lēctiōne, tractandō eās ut ōrnāmenta sine ūllā fūnctiōne.
commonMistakes.right: Legere particulās ut mappam argūmentī/nārrātiōnis: γάρ = venit explicātiō; οὖν = venit conclūsiō; ἀλλά = venit obiectiō/contrāstus.
commonMistakes.why: Discipulus quī neglegit particulās perdet magnam partem structūrae logicae textūs authenticī, quamvīs vocābulum ipsum comprehendat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Timēre complexitātem sententiārum longārum (stilus periodicus) tamquam sī requīrerent grammaticam novam nōn adhūc discitam.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī: perīodus longa est combīnātiō elementōrum GRAMMATICĒ iam nōtōrum (participia, genetīvī absolūtī, clausulae subōrdinātae) — sōlum architectūra est nova, nōn vocābulum grammaticum ipsum.
commonMistakes.why: Encouragement fīnālis: discipulus quī cōnfīdenter applicat Gradūs I-VI potest, cum patientiā, dēcōdificāre quamlibet sententiam Thucydideam, particulā post particulam.

Quem cāsum accipit agēns in cōnstrūctiōne -τέος?

options: nōn, est architectūra/organizātiō, sīcut ex elementīs iam nōtīs
items.explanation: Discrīmen est stilisticum, nōn grammaticum fundāmentāle.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Λέγω acceptat ambās cōnstrūctiōnēs, acc.+īnf. et ὅτι+modus fīnītus.
Particulae postpositīvae (γάρ, δέ, οὖν) portant sōlum decorātiōnem stilisticam, sine fūnctiōne logicā.
items.explanation: Falsum: struunt argūmentum/nārrātiōnem, essentiālēs prō sēnsū plēnō.

items.statement: Post Gradum VI, discipulus habet fundāmentum grammaticum sufficiēns ad affrontāre textūs authenticōs (Gradus VII).

exercises.title: Iunge Verbum cum Cōnstrūctiōne
exercises.instructions: Iunge quodque verbum cum cōnstrūctiōne oblīquā propriā suā.

items.explanation: Cōnstrūctiō dēpendet ā classe sēmanticā verbī: dīcendī/putandī vs. sciendī/percipiendī.

exercises.title: Complē cum Fōrmā Rēctā
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā, applicāns syntaxem integram Gradūs VI.

Μέν semper antīcipat, alicubi in contextū:
Post Gradum VI, vocābulum rārius (nōn grammatica) est:

items.statement: Datīvus possessiōnis cum εἰμί est aequivalēns idiōmaticum 'habēre'.
Stilus periodicus combīnat elementa grammaticē iam nōta in architectūrā complexā.
Gradus VII removet omne adiūtōrium adaptātiōnis, offerēns verba ipsa antīquōrum.

summary: Trēs cōnstrūctiōnēs ōrātiōnis oblīquae, ēlēctae secundum classem verbī: acc.+īnf. (dīcendī), ὅτι/ὡς (nūntiandī), acc.+participium (sciendī/percipiendī).
-τέος (necessitās, agēns datīvō) vs. -τός (possibilitās). Systēma cāsuum temporāle: acc./gen./dat. = per quantum/intrā/quō pūnctō.
Particulae postpositīvae struunt argūmentum; ἀλλά marcat contrāstum fortem; μέν/δέ marcant balantiam.
Complexitās stilistica (perīodus Thucydideus) est organizātiō elementōrum iam nōtōrum, nōn grammatica nova.
Gradus VI conclūditur: discipulus est praeparātus ad Gradum VII, textūs authenticōs sine adaptātiōne.
